[EN] Have any firewhiskey on you? I swear, I will never come to Kaiator again without a large sleeve of it.

It's as cold as a witch's toe out here!
[ES] ¿Tienes algo de firewhiskey encima? ¡Te juro que nunca volveré a Kaiator sin una buena provisión de eso!

¡Hace un frío que pela por aquí!
